summary: Opus review pass 1. Fixed 1 critical, 5 high and 8 medium defects. Critical: RateLimitMiddleware was attached to dp.update but type-checked Message/CallbackQuery, so rate limiting never fired in production (acceptance 13). High: stale cached file_id raised unhandled; progress edits from the yt-dlp thread could overwrite the final card; .webp thumbnails made sendVideo fail; TikTok no-watermark ranking was inverted; temp files unbounded before the size check. Medium: unguarded edit_text ("message is not modified"), dispatcher not re-creatable, no job ownership check in groups, double-tap double download, no overall extraction timeout, wrong-token traceback, heartbeat loop dying, ffmpeg-missing degradation. Added tests/test_regressions.py (20) and tests/test_integration.py (13, real Updates through a real Dispatcher). Suite 89 → 129, ruff + ruff format + mypy --strict clean on a fresh clone. Verified without a live token: acceptance 1, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14. Not verifiable here: 2–8, 11 (need BOT_TOKEN), 15 (no Docker), real ffmpeg paths.

findings.title: Docker container runs as root
findings.details: No unprivileged user in the image; not changed because Docker is unavailable locally to verify the healthcheck.

findings.title: Peak temp usage for merged formats is about 2x MAX_FILE_MB
findings.details: Per-stream cap: video and audio parts each capped independently before merge.

findings.title: TikTok short links cache separately from the canonical URL
findings.details: vm./vt.tiktok.com links are not resolved to the canonical video id before caching.

findings.title: Instagram auth-error markers are broad
findings.details: Deleted/private posts may be reported as a cookies problem.

findings.title: Graceful shutdown does not wait for in-flight uploads
findings.details: Only downloads are counted in wait_idle(); a sendVideo in progress can be cut on SIGTERM.

findings.title: A failed ffmpeg merge can yield a silent video
findings.details: _find_output prefers video-only leftovers if a merge fails.

findings.title: Acceptance items 2-8, 11 and 15 unverified locally
findings.details: Need a live BOT_TOKEN, Docker and ffmpeg; items 4, 6, 7, 8, 11 touch the changed code paths and deserve attention in the live test.

fixed: Rate limiting never fired: middleware on dp.update received Update, not Message; added unwrap_event() and dispatcher-level test
Stale/revoked cached file_id no longer raises; dead row dropped and real download performed
Progress callbacks can no longer overwrite the final result card (progress_open guard)
YouTube .webp thumbnails: filter to compliant JPEG, convert when ffmpeg present, retry sendVideo without thumbnail
TikTok watermark ranking fixed (lexicographic: clean, yt-dlp preference, height/bitrate) and detection matches real yt-dlp labels
Temp files bounded: progress hook aborts past the cap, max_filesize passed to yt-dlp
safe_edit() wraps all message edits; 'message is not modified' no longer unhandled in /settings and links
Handlers expose build_router() so create_dispatcher() can be called more than once
Job ownership check: foreign users cannot drive another user's card
Double-tap protection via per-job busy claim
60 s overall timeout on metadata extraction
Wrong BOT_TOKEN prints a clear message and exits 2
ffmpeg missing: FfmpegMissingError with ru/en message and progressive-stream fallback
Rate-limit deque GC and math.ceil wait time
